newsitem.title: GERMANY: ANALYSIS-Depfa says UBS has stake.
newsitem.headline: ANALYSIS-Depfa says UBS has stake.

text.p: The following are comments by banking analysts on the statement by German mortgage bank DePfa-Bank AG that it believes Switzerland's UBS group has bought a nine percent stake in it.
DePfa says UBS has not confirmed that it has a large stake, and that UBS said its research has shown its holdings in Depfa are below one percent.
CHRISTINE WINKLER, bank analyst at Bayerische Hypotheken und Wechsel Bank AG, Munich.

"I would interpret this as a clear defence attempt by DePfa. If they are correct and UBS actually does have nine percent, then on top of that comes their involvement in Schweizerische Lebensversicherungs- und Rentenanstalt a.G (a major shareholder in Depfa), with 8.2 percent, then they really do have a substantial stake.
This was a surprise. On the other hand, it has been clear for some time that UBS was interested in the German market although speculation never centred on DePfa.
The bank could be interesting for UBS with regard to European business, particularly with regard to its euro business.
DePfa has also concentrated very much on European business and has declared its goal to become the leading European public finance bank. Naturally that could be of interest.
